nom: Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye

avis.titre: This product wasn't worth the price. Didn't improve anything
avis.texte: I think they are selling the Name This product showed no improvement for that price you might as well use a cheaper brand

avis.titre: Best eye serum I have ever tried
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing. I like that you can actually see the three ingredients.

avis.titre: Bought 2 bottles now, hoping for a LT results
avis.texte: I'm in my 30s and have somewhat dry, and some fine lines under my eyes. I got the first bottle during 50% off sale and thought this worked fine, in combination with the lancome HCF face serum. I can't say that I see dramatic improvement but I figured I would use 2 bottles and see if I can see the effect. Overall, I'd say it is good enough but does not 'visibly' erase my fine lines. Texture is a bit light so I do later eye cream on top on colder months or when my undereyes are extra dry.

avis.titre: I would not purchase this again
avis.texte: This is the second bottle of the mixture that I have purchased. The first was a face cream and only one of the 3 openings worked. This bottle was eye mixture and it seems to be too oily and again, only 1 of the openings works. I will be not purchasing these againl

I've been using this product since mid August 1-2x a day and have really seen a difference in dark circles and fine lines around my eyes. I really like the triple serum, but for the longest time all three serums would not dispense simultaneously. In the beginning the only thing that came out was the clear serum, followed by the beige one, then finally the white cream. Another thing, if you are dark skinned be advised that there is a bit of white cast/blue color to the cream and it may be more noticeable if youre darker skinned. For reference I'm NC43/47 in Mac and I wont use this product if im planning to go out bare faced. Overall I enjoy the product, it has definitely addressed concerns I had for my eye area.

avis.titre: Quality product that stung my eyes
avis.texte: This is definitely a quality product- it's Lancome after all. Eye area felt more hydrated and overall surrounding skin was supple after overnight use. I'm a contact wearer so maybe my eyes are a bit more sensitive, but the thin consistency of this serum really contributed to product getting into and irritating my eyes. I found it harder to remain super consistent because of this, but it's not for lack of results.

I am a huge fan of the Lancome brand. The product was easy to apply and went on so smoothly. It absorbed into my skin quickly and was not greasy at all. I did find that my skin looked more hydrated and glowing than before. Did it take away my fine under eye lines, no. Would I buy it for my skin care routine, yes becuase of the hydration!

Let me preface this review by stating that I was on the search for the best serum that had multiple uses and in my search, this Regenerie H.C.F. Triple Serum consistently came up. I read about all these amazing results that people were having from crows feet diminishing to dark spots disappearing and decided to give it a chance. I have been using this serum every single day for the past three months and have not experienced one change! In fact, I think some of my wrinkles are even getting worse! I'm extremely disappointed, considering the amount of money I paid for this so called "miracle serum". Definitely NOT Lancome's best product.

I have tried a lot of eye creams, but was always frustrated because even though they were hydrating they never did anything for my fine lines and dark circles. I have been using this product for a week and the fine lines have VANISHED. My undereye skin is plump, and my dark circles have diminshed. Very impressed!!!!

First product I've used where I've seen results (41 btw). It's pricey but worth every penny. I love lancôme! Best skincare in my opinion and I've tried many. Only issue is the pump, takes a few days to get all 3 serums...
Just as any other cosmetic item, it takes time after using this product for a week my under eyes feel smoother and brighter. This is expensive, but you don't have to use a lot.

First of all, this bottle is so pretty and looks great to have sitting out. The pump distributes the two formulas evenly while providing lightweight but effective moisture for around the eye area. It feeäs great on skin and I have noticed diminished lines and puffiness.

I really like the packaging on this product, I like that the active ingredients are kept separate until time of use. This eye cream did not feel heavy on my skin. My eyes seem to respond slowly to new creams so I am still awaiting final results. I like that this eye cream did not have a heavy scent.

This product because it truly does work. I was able to see a difference within a couple of weeks. It has a light scent and hydrates all those under eye circles and fine lines around your eyes. I highly recommend this product to all the working and tired mommy's out there.

I don't know how this stuff works but it works great. It is super moisturizing and makes my undereyes look great. I love how it dispenses out of the dispenser. It comes out in three different little nozzles at the same time, I absolutely love it

this serum is very light weight. you just need a small amount to cover your eye area and tap the product in. the next day results are very noticable. it fills in your fine lines. makes your skin look plump.

avis.titre: Silky smooth, good results- but pricey!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this product. It is so silky smooth and spreads lovely around my eye area. I really liked the scent (which is rare for me!) and it didn't cause any breakouts. I saw good results, I was able to skip concealer with frequent use of this product. It also seemed to help my makeup lay better on my under eyes. I just wish it wasn't so pricey! I'm willing to spend money on Prestige brands- but probably not this one. The ingredients are pretty common in most eye treatments, and I think this one is just way overpriced.

I wanted to like this; my mom swears by Lancome skincare, but I've never used much more than soap, water, and moisturizer, up till I started seeing signs of aging (I'm 36 and am juuust starting to see fine lines, crow's feet etc). I used this every morning for a couple weeks straight and saw no results. About the only thing it did was de-puff my eyes, but even that was inconsistent. If it were otherwise inoffensive, I would probably finish the bottle, but it stings and leaves a weird, sticky residue that lasted hours. Maybe someone else more used to products like these might not mind, but it isn't me!
I loved the packaging and application. Pricey but large amount of product and lasts. Luxurious and effective

avis.titre: A new staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I Love this product. I have been using it for about 3 weeks and I can already tell a huge difference in my skin! I am 45, dry sensitive skin. I haven't had any issues with my sensitivity at all. This is a serum that makes your skin feel like silk and well hydrated. I feel like my fine lines around my eyes are less noticeable .I definitely recommended this product. It does have a mild scent that I didn't find bothersome at all. I can see a visible difference that has made me feel more confident definitely a new addition to my skin care routine.

After just a few weeks I saw a difference. My lines had faded. I saw a glow as well because the product is so hydrating. I did have to be careful when applying though because I have very sensitive eyes. I got it in my eye once and it stung bad and caused my eye to water for awhile. As long as I was careful, it was all good!

I love to use this serum for my skin routine, serum makes my skin glow, really hydrating. The packaging looks luxury. It makes my skin looks brighter, smoother and defined with less wrinkles. The serum has a lightweight, silky texture, you won't feel any greasy or sticky residue. It's a great serum, I highly recommend this serum.
This triple eye serum has all the ingredients needed for my eyes. My skin feels and smells great.

Let me start out by saying I have used many products, from retail to professional. This serum is surprisingly decent. I like the concept of the ingredients combining together at the top. It has great slip and is easy to apply. I noticed subtle changes within a few weeks. I'm looking forward to more changes.

Lancome Renergie Yeux H.C.F. Triple Serum is a very cool concept as it mixes three formulas of eye cream into one. The gel formula is soothing when I apply it each morning and evening, and I've noticed improved skin clarity and firmness in my eye area over a month of use. I would highly recommend.

This serum is amazing in my opinion. It is a non greasy serum that absorbs in the skin nicely. It goes on smoothly and left my eyes feeling soft and supple. I have noticed less puffiness under my eyes and the fine lines are less noticeable. I will continue to use this product. I feel like I look younger than I have in a long time.

I was so please to try this for the first time, as I have been in search of finding an eye care serum that could help me bring the youthful smooth surface and alleviate the wrinkles and aging process. It gave my under-eyes the smooth surface I've been addressing and gave me confidence as I mature in life, It's a great product with proven results. I am so glad they came up with this formulation. Non greasy. Absorbent. Nice fragrance. Light. Perfect!

This as a new texture serum that I have not tried in the past. I normally use a thicker eye cream but this one is a serum that has a triple serum system that mixes the three once dispensed. I found it to be lightweight, brightening and hydrating. I found this did help alleviate puffiness and did not cause milia, but I found the packaging in need of improvement.

I use the product every night before bed, for the past 4 weeks. The product has a nice smell. Feels great on my skin around my eyes. I had a few small lines, and I have noticed they have become less noticeable now. I will continue to use the product. I'm interested in the outcome

I have really been enjoying this eye serum. I like how the 3 different formulas pump out separately and I mix them as I apply. My eye area is very hydrated and that gives me a glow that I love. This serum performs really well under makeup and keeps the cakey concealer look away. I feel like this product is lovely, has a lightweight feel, it absorbs into the skin nicely. With all that said, I'm not sure my results are night and day. I should have taken before and after photos. It is a really nice serum and I'm glad to have added it to my routine.

This product feels really nourishing and hydrating to the skin and the coverage is fantastic! Definitely only need one pump to cover your entire face. It doesn't feel sticky or anything after application. I'm a big fan and will be adding this to my facecare regime.

avis.titre: Hydrate your eyes & forget about it!
avis.texte: I love a serum. & I love an eye cream. This is the best of both worlds. I use at night under my moisturizer. Helps with puffiness & makes my under eye look moisturized.

I have been using the triple serum for a few weeks now. I was a bit skeptical at first but, WOW! I have seen a reduction in eye puffiness, fine lines, and dryness. I have rosacea and was concerned about irritation. I am happy to say, I had no problems whatsoever. A few of my coworkers asked if I had botox or something. Nope, just used this triple serum. Highly recommend.

I have been using this for a few weeks & I love it. My skin looks amazing & it is helping make my aging skin look younger. I would definitely buy this product & I would recommend it to my friends & co workers.

avis.titre: Expected a lot more for this price
avis.texte: I reaaaally wanted to love this product. I have used Lancome products in the past and have loved everything I've tried. This one, not so much. So I'll start with the pros: Packaging- it's lovely and looks nice sitting out. I like the way the pump works. Once you get it going, the product flows evenly. Performance- It does a great job firming the skin around the eye area. Now for the cons. Packaging-it doesn't say anywhere on the bottle how to use the product so hopefully you kept the box it came in which describes how to use it. Performance-this stung my eyes sooo much! It did not matter how carefully I applied or tried to stay out of the way of the eye, this stuff really likes to migrate into the eye. This is the biggest reason why I just can't justify another purchase of this. It also didn't really do anything for my wrinkles which would have been my reason for purchasing.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product feels so luxurious on and it really helped with my under eye bags.

avis.titre: Beautiful product for aging under eyes!
avis.texte: Used this product for a few weeks to give it a true test. The thin consistency is perfect and wont cause milia from being too thick. My under eyes look brighter, more refreshed and youthful and I've now added it to my daily routine!

avis.titre: I really enjoy this hydrating eye serum
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary in exchange for honest feedback. I have been enjoying the Triple Serum Eye. I like how the three serums come out of the pump separately and then I mix them together as I apply. This serum is very lightweight and has a soft scent. It blends in very quickly and easily and does not leave a greasy residue. I feel like the skin around my eyes is very hydrated and has a glow. This serum performs really well under makeup. I have been so pleased to add this to my routine.

I was recently gifted the Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum to try in exchange for my honest review, and I have to say, I was genuinely pleased with the results. The unique triple-chamber design, which combines hyaluronic acid, vitamin C + niacinamide, and ferulic acid, immediately caught my attention. After using it for a few weeks, I noticed a significant improvement in the brightness and firmness around my eyes. The fine lines and puffiness have visibly reduced, giving my eyes a more youthful appearance. The serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated without any greasy residue. I also enjoyed the very light fragrance, which added a pleasant sensory experience to my skincare routine. Although I did notice a slight stickiness right after application, it wasn't a deal-breaker for me. Overall, I'm very pleased with the results and would recommend it to others.

This eye serum felt nice, light weight and absorbed well. I felt it was very hydrating, however the product also claims it smooths fine lines, reduces puffiness and brightens. I have not noticed any difference in those areas after using this product twice a day for 3 weeks. I will continue to use it though because it is hydrating and maybe it just takes more time to see a difference.

I would first like to say thank you to BzzAgent for sending me Lancome's Renergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum to try free of charge, in exchange for my honest opinion. Growing up, Lancome was practically a household name. My grandmother used Lancome, my mother used Lancome, and both me and my sisters have used Lancome products, so I was really excited to be given an opportunity to try their new eye serum. This serum's main ingredients are hyaluronic acid, peptides, niacinamide, and vitamin E-all of which are greatly beneficial to the skin around the eyes. The product itself comes well contained in an airless pump with three separate chambers that mix together once dispensed. For my A.M. routine I normally use a serum followed by a cream, but after using this for about three weeks, I found myself skipping the cream, as the serum was enough by itself. It tightened and de-puffed my undereye area quite well and imparted enough moisture without being greasy or heavy. I additionally really appreciate the fact that the product sank in and absorbed fairly quick, and my makeup wore well on top of it. All in all, this is a luxurious, well formulated product that has the classic Lancome quality I've come to expect.

avis.titre: I love how this eye serum feels
avis.texte: I received this amazing h.c.f eye serum to test. And I love it I have been dealing with bags under my eyes the older I get I have tried other products but this seems to work the best. First when applying it leaves a nice cool tingling sensation on the skin I apply it every morning and it has definitely helped with my bags as well as some wrinkles. I really have no complaints about this product and recommend picking it up

I'm now on my third week of using Lancôme's Renergie Triple Eye Serum and all I can say is… WOW. Before using this serum, I had recently completed three cosmetic treatments targeting the eye area, which cost a fortune! At that point, my eye area still looked frustratingly older than the rest of my face. But after a few weeks of using Renergie every night, I'm seeing a remarkable improvement around my eyes. My under eye is also staying better hydrated throughout the day, which big time improves my makeup routine. Best of all, I wear contacts and have naturally sensitive eyes. Usually, eye serums leave me with burning eyes, but I've had zero such problems with Renergie. So happy with this one!

avis.titre: Nice but i don't know about the price
avis.texte: I likke how it blends into my skin. My skins feels refreshed and hydrated. It's pretty silk smooth almost like water. It is pretty thin so maybe this is betteer for daytime. No noticiable improvements or changes however. I will continue to use it.

This is one of the BEST eye cream / serum I've used. I've tried a lot of different types of products over the years to prevent fine lines and wrinkles under and around my eyes. Lancome really hit it out of the park with this anti-aging Triple Serum. I wanted to try the product for a couple weeks before I left a review and I'm glad I did. This product is three separate products that get mixed in the palm of your hand before application under the eye. I think that makes it a little more different than the other products on the market. Each of the three separate serums are silky, disappeared quickly after applying, and leave your under eye area of feeling hydrated. (I think it's the peptides that make the difference) :). I think I've noticed the difference in my eyes now I would say you would have to probably use it for 6 to 12 weeks before you really can see a difference. I've used it for almost 6 weeks and the tiny crows-feet area I have on my left diminished some and no other ones have formed or gotten deeper or more noticeable. I'm not sure what else she can expect from an eye serum. That's pretty much it. It's not magic in a bottle, just yet. Maybe someday right. I will also say, one thing I look for in a product is the way that the product is bottled. A selling point for me, how the bottle feels in my hands and is the bottle appealing to me to look at. Lamb come hit it out of the park on that one too. The bottle design, with the ombre purple. Perfect! I love it. I'm gonna

Sometimes eye products are a bit of a trial and error and it can be wasteful to even bother with, but this one worked in time. Good things take time! It took a few tries to get the "triple serum" dispensed but very nice blend of product. Pricey but worth it

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I had a very difficult time getting the product to dispense from all three spots. Still, I'm only able to use product from two spots and had to waste a lot of one product to get it to this point. Also, I believe the product has an overwhelming fragrance that lingers all day. During the use, I also noticed increased blemishes, more than likely from the fragrance.

avis.titre: Definitely adding this to my routine!
avis.texte: I will definitely buy again! I subscribe to several dermatologists on YouTube and TikTok. Some of them say that you don't really need a separate eye cream or serum; that the serums/creams you use on your face are basically the same thing as eye specific products. I've been doing that for a while now, but this serum is different, and I think the intense hydrating effect makes it worth purchasing a separate product for my eyes. I have an involved skincare regimen using Korean and Japanese products, but I haven't gotten the same amount of plumping around my eyes when using my facial products as eye cream/serum. This serum is lightweight and not greasy. It glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It has a clean smell, but it isn't strong. I have oily but dehydrated skin with the skin around my eyes being incredibly dry. This serum definitely made the skin around my eyes look smoother and feel plumper. I have seen some reduction in fine lines under my eyes which appears to be due to the serums plumping effect.
I was very excited to try this product based on the promising reviews but I haven't noticed any drastic changes around my eye area.

I fell in love with the serum after using it for only a few weeks. I love how hydrated and smooth my skin feels after it is applied. I have even noticed some of my sunspots starting to diminish. I recommend this product all my friends.
Unfortunately the pump was not pumping out all 3 products in the same amount. The first 15-20 pumps was all the same. This also had a very perfume like smell which I did not like.

Viscosity is silky water based and applies without drag, so smooth. Pump dispenses way more than necessary so careful with that. Smell is almost void, fragrance free. Hydrates really well and helps provide a well rested eye. Here's the issue, it takes quite a long time for it to fully absorb and dry. If makeup is applied the serum will break up and apart which makes for a time consuming issue to deal with cleaning it up to get back to normal routine. Night application of course zero issue.

I used this product for a few weeks. I get a lot of dryness and eczema around my eyes, and this product wasn't really moisturizing enough for me. But when I started using it just in the mornings, and using a heavier eye cream at night, I had really good results. I do think this product made a difference in brightening my very dark under-eyes, and I think there was a nice tightening/plumping effect as well. I don't love the packaging. It's pretty big and bulky for the amount of product in there! And I think one of the three little serums ran out faster than the others.

avis.titre: A must have in my routine!
avis.texte: This eye serum is a great addition to my skin care routine. It smells great and is very hydrating!

avis.titre: This product feels so good on your skin!
avis.texte: I used Lancôme Renergie Yeux HCF Triple Serum eye concentrate almost every morning. I loved the feel of it, and it was a generous amount. It took several pumps before all serums came out. I do feel like it helped eye puffiness and fine lines around my eyes. That being said, I don't generally have problems l/lines/puffiness around my eyes as much as other areas of my face that need help! I would recommend this product, but also feel it's a little pricey.

This works well under make up and it's lightweight. The place well with other serums and moisturizers and absorbs quickly so it's excellent for use under concealer. It takes a bit to start seeing noticeable results but it's worth the wait.
This product makes my undereye area nice and hydrated. Helps minimize my dark circles. Doesn't leave any sticky residue, my makeup applies smoothly over it.

avis.titre: Staple serum for your skincare routine
avis.texte: I can always trust Lancome to make incredible skincare that truly nourishes and benefits your skin. I saw results with this eye serum, which greatly improved the appearance of the fine lines around my delicate eye area. Very pleased with how quickly it absorbed and that it was okay on my sensitive skin!

The Lancome Renergie HCF Triple Eye Serum is a great addition to my night time routine. After a week of regular use, I could see the skin under my eyes was a little firmer with some fine line reduction. The bottle is also very pretty on my counter and the scent is pleasant. You don't need much so the bottle should last a while. Took off one star because the price is steep.

I use this product at night and also in the morning and it is a visible difference. I have been using this product for approximately four weeks now and people are actually commenting on the difference that they say. The lotion itself is a lightweight field not greasy at all, and the packaging that it comes in is super adorable. I would definitely recommend to purchase this product!

A lot of eye products are super thick, but this isn't. Very silk texture and feels great on the skin. Also love the bottle! Very nice. the only thing I didn't like is that it is scented, which is probably fine if you don't have sensitive skin!
This product had two products in one. Combined nicely and smells good. Seems to work ok, haven't noticed to much difference with it yet.

I do not normally use eye creams, as I don't see visible improvements and most of them end up clogging my pores. However, I really like this Lancome Eye Serum! Very pleasantly surprised to see a noticeable improvement in my under-eye darkness. And no clogged pores as of yet. Impressed!
After a couple weeks I noticed a huge difference with dark circles and puffiness

The packaging is beautiful! However, it took many pumps before all 3 liquids came together out of the bottle. Once it did, it mage my skin feel amazing. I really noticed a difference in texture and softness within a few days using morning and night.

avis.titre: The great product for younger looking eyes
avis.texte: I've been using this product for 2 weeks under my eyes and also unlike crow's feet. I have seen it some visible results in the short amount of time but I definitely think the results will be better when I continue to use the product. The product goes on smooth a little bit goes such a long ways it's not sticky or oily. I would definitely recommend this for someone who likes a luxury product and is trying to maintain young beautiful skin.

avis.titre: Lancôme Renergie H.C.F. TRIPLE SERUM EYE
avis.texte: Lancôme Renergie H.C.F. TRIPLE SERUM EYE is hydrating and can be used under an eye cream for even more hydration if desired. Will purchase in the future.

Lancôme Rénergie HCF Triple Eye Serum is a highly effective eye treatment that targets multiple signs of aging. Its unique formula combines Hyaluronic Acid, Caffeine, and a blend of vitamins to address dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines. Users often report noticeable improvements in skin texture and brightness, with the serum's lightweight texture allowing for quick absorption without any greasy residue. The inclusion of innovative ingredients helps to enhance firmness and elasticity around the delicate eye area. Overall, this eye serum is well-regarded for its comprehensive approach to eye care, offering visible results and a luxurious feel. It goes on smooth and did not give me any irritation. I saw results within two weeks of using this serum. However, it comes with a higher price tag, which might be a consideration for some users.

I have been using Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum for several weeks after receiving a free sample in exchange for my review. The bottle is high end, as you'd expect from Lancome. It has a pump top with three dispensing holes (hence "triple serum"). Per the instructions, I primed the pump by pumping it 8-10 times. Clear serum appeared as in the picture below, and I swirled to mix (even though I couldn't tell if different products were emerging from the dispenser). O.M.G. was this serum hydrating. I was amazed by the how hydrated it made the skin around my eyes feel. It made me think of one of those snail masks I tried once, but not sticky. The word "hydration" just kept coming unbidden to my mind over and over. I used this twice a day for 7 days and then was surprised when some white cream also came out of one or both of the dispensing holes. So this time when I swirled before applying I was actually mixing something. I have used the product for 2 weeks since more than the clear serum came out. It feels nice, but I don't have the overwhelming sensation of hydration I did the first week with just the clear product. I'm a woman in my mid 50's so fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes are a concern. I really feel like this product does more than most to combat the fine lines and wrinkles and promotes elasticity. It has a nice scent, it hydrates, it makes me feel like I'm pampering myself --and let's face it, who doesn't want to be pampered? My only criticism is related to packaging.

avis.titre: A perfect addition to skincare routine
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month now as part of my skincare routine. It's a great addition as I was looking for an eye serum with vitamin c. My under eyes have been so smooth and the skin is not saggy as much. I will definitely continue this with my routine

Lancôme Renergie Yeux HCF Triple Serum is a highly advanced luxury serum that combines 3 separate serums to combat the signs of aging. It combines a gel serum with Hyaluronic Acid, a serum emulsion with vitamin c and a cream serum with vitamin F to help tighten, lift, and smooth global eye contour. I love the way it blends the 3 serums to make one potent anti aging complex! The scent is light and pleasant. Make sure to put the bottle on a flat surface to ensure that the 3 serums distribute evenly. Highly recommended!

So while I received this product to review, I would have bought it regardless because I am a lifelong Lancome fan. I wanted to love this just as much as I love its big brother, the HCF Triple skin serum. But while the serum itself I think is great, I noticed less lines, less under-eye bags, tons of moisture, 3 things hold me back from loving this and potentially putting it in my routine. The 3 holes took about 20 or so pumps to finally dispense at the same time. The skin serum usually needs 3 or 4, which seems less wasteful. The amount of times I had to try this in order to get all 3 to dispense, was not great. 2nd, also with the pump, 1 full pump is way too much product, I end up using half on my face. So I'm always using half a pump, which is fine, but the right amount would be nice with a full pump. 3rd, a problem that I used to encounter with the other Renegie eye product, if it gets in your eyes, forget it. It stings so much! My eye ends up watering to the point where it takes all the product away, or I have to walk around for 20 mins with one eye closed, or I end up rubbing it all off. The packaging is beautiful, looks amazing with its bigger sidekick. the product does what it says, tackling lines, moisture, undereye bags. But the dispensing method and the product painful side effects, makes me think I won't be purchasing this, and sticking to my absolue eye products.
I've been using this product morning and night and it has helped smooth the lines around my eyes! Creamy and love that it doesn't have a strong scent

Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye is working well for me. I've been applying it day and night and my under eye area seems to be looking less dark and less puffy. It's a nice formula which is thick enough but easy to soak in. You only need a small amount to do the job. The scent is pleasant and I'm really liking this brand. I will continue to use for more results.

A LOT of the product came out of the pump when using. I would have been fine with a fourth of what was disbursed for my needs. It did dry rather quickly but, oh my gosh, I absolutely saw a slight reduction in fine lines around my eyes! Skin was soft and smooth, it was non irritating as well. I didn't really feel it made the skin around my eyes any more luminous but I still think this is a fantastic serum for eyes.

I've been interested in trying this out for a while so I was excited when I had the opportunity to do so. Besides a beautiful package, the main star of this is definitely the combination of three different formulas pumping out together to create this beautiful smooth and hydrating appearance. This hydrated, tightened, brightened and smoothed while really improving the overall appearance in only a few short weeks. I'm definitely going to keep using this product for the multitude of benefits it's provided.
I'm 42 years old and had started to notice under eye circles and small creasing. I have been using this product for the past two weeks and I have noticed a difference in my under eye area.

avis.titre: Nice but price is high for the product
avis.texte: This was a nice serum that was lightweight and did t leave any residue. I wasn't impressed with the brightening as it did not help with my dark circles. The ordinary is equally as effective and a fraction of the price
I have only been using this product for about 2 weeks and already my dark circles have significantly improved! Even the skin under my eyes looks smooth and younger. This product is great!

I was excited to receive a feee sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. Unfortunately, this product didn't really work for me. It stings when I put it on the sensitive skin around my eyes. It also burns if you get it in your eye, and your eye stays red for a full day (for any other clumsy folks). Additionally, I had a hard time getting all three of the products to come out of the packaging, I mostly just got the clear one out.

avis.titre: A new favorite in my skin routine!
avis.texte: After introducing this new eye cream to my skin routine it has become a new favorite! I love the formula and the way it feels under my eyes. There is no irritation or burning. As a contact wearer I am always weary of eye products and try to ensure that I keep to those that won't interfere with my use of contacts. I had no issues with wearing the serum and my contacts. I noticed my under eyes felt smoother and the fine line I was starting to see were definitely less noticeable after 3 weeks of use. The only issue I had was the scent, I tend to prefer a neutral smell for face products but this was not something that was deter me from continuing to use daily. Overall I am pleased with my results and will continue to use!

This is the best anti aging eye serum I have used in many years. When it first comes out of the very beautiful bottle it's in may I add, there are 2 different kinds of creams that come out and you mix them in the palm of your hand then put it on your face. It is so soft and silky and all you need is a dime size amount cause a little goes a long way. With in the first few days of using it I could already tell a difference in my skin around my eyes. It was noticeably tighter especially in my crows feet area and underneath. I definitely recommend and will be purchasing again for myself.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review from bzz agent. I have extremely sensitive eyes and this is one of the few eye products that I've tried that doesn't seem to irritate them. No itching, watering, or rash. It is extremely hydrating, and I do believe that it has started to help with discoloration and my fine lines. Do I think you need to run out and get it? Maybe. Is it a must buy? Absolutely not, but it is really nice.

I used this serum twice a day for 6 weeks. It is moisturizing. The smell is not bad. I haven't really noticed any difference in my under eye area. It's one of my problem areas and I really wish this worked better.

I recieved this cream from BzzAgent for an honest review. The cream has a pleasant odor. It has a nice viscosity and applies to my skin smoothly with out leaving a residue. The cream helps briggten my dark circles and ensures I do not have bags. My eyes look bright and refreshed each morning. I believe it is helping my fine lines also.

avis.titre: I'm impressed by how quickly it works!
avis.texte: I have high expectations for eye serums because I've seen some really awesome results in the past, and this one doesn't disappoint. I like the triple formula too! I do one pump on the back of my hand, which I mix with a fingertip and then apply to the eye area. There's usually a little more than I actually need, so I just rub it into the backs of both of my hands for a little anti aging boost there too. This formula dries quickly without feeling sticky or tacky and it feels really light. My eyes look younger and less lined after just a few weeks. I'm a fan!

avis.titre: I enjoyed this product it was luxurious
avis.texte: I used this product twice a day under my eyes and it was moisturizing and helped me with all my anti aging issues. I would definitely buy this product again.

I thought this stuff was going to be amazing, but I can't really tell if it's doing anything. Maybe my lines are too fine to see results. It does feel nice though. It's not runny or thick and it absorbs well. It layers easily with other products. The bottle is so pretty, but is made of plastic. It feels cheap and for the price should be heavier and more luxurious.

avis.titre: Might need more time to see results
avis.texte: I like the smell and the texture of the product, though it does leave an oily feeling on my eye lids and below my eyes. I have used the product for 3 weeks daily, and have not seen much of a difference in fine lines or wrinkles yet. I'm going to give it some more time and hope to see results.
I use the product day/night & I feel like it has improved the crepeyness under my eyes. My eyes look younger & brighter. I would definitely repurchase!

This eye serum was not a product I could use due to my sensitive skin and allergies and sensitivity to scented products. The first thing I noticed after dispensing the serum onto my hand was a strong, sharp citrusy odor. This caused my eyes and nose to burn and water. The odor dissipated after the serum fully absorbed but my eyes remained irritated until I washed the product off 30 minutes later. Like other reviewers mentioned, I had problems getting all 3 components of the serum to dispense. I wasted quite a bit of product before the 3rd component finally dispensed. At this price point I don't want to waste a drop. I have used Lancome Genifique serum for several years and will continue with that. I received a free bottle of this product in exchange for my honest review. If I had purchased this product I would have returned it not only for the fact that it irritated my skin and eyes, but also because so much product was wasted because of the faulty dispenser.

I received this product to test and review, and was very excited at the opportunity because let's face it - I'm only getting older! At first look, the packaging is very luxurious and high end, as expected from Lancome - however in the few weeks using the product, I'm unsure if I am truly getting all of the serums within the bottle. When you pump the bottle, there are separate exit holes intended to keep the serum separate until application. I find myself using extra pumps to make sure I am getting all the product, but then that leads to waste, ad I then have too much product to use. The serum itself is light and easily absorbed, without much of a scent. It does leave my eyes feeling refreshed, and does not take long at all for the product to absorb. I've seen an improvement in the fine lines around my eyes, and feel that with prolonged use, they will continue to improve. I also love how this product layers with other skincare and I don't have to worry about any products willing. I would recommend this product overall, but hope that some improvement is made to the packaging

This eye serum is a two in one. When you push the top button, two different serums are released. You then mix these up before applying. Not much is needed, so one push is enough for both under eye areas. The feel is soft and luxurious, but don't get this in your eyes- it does burn. Although I did not notice much difference after using, I did like the feel of it. I wish it was more moistizing.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This is a really nice product for fine lines and wrinkles. A little goes a long way and it soaks into the skin quickly! I look forward to seeing the results with prolonged use.

I really love the Lancôme Renergie Yeux HCF Triple Serum. I've been using this for several weeks and I see a difference under my eyes, The serum is very silky & smooth and feels good under the eyes. A little goes a long way, I would definitely recommend this serum!

The results for this is shocking. Literally immediately you can feel your face tightening. The second I put this around my eyes my eyes immediately looked more youthful. I highly recommend this product for anyone looking to tighten up your skin and have a youthful glow.
The texture and feel of this product is amazing! It is silky smooth and has made a huge difference in the hydration of my under eyes. I highly recommend!

I have a drier eye area and so this was not enough on it's own as an eye cream. I layered it with another eye cream I had been using previously but did not see any changes. Just didn't seem worth it to me unfortunately.

After using Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum for the past few weeks, I have noticed less puffiness and tired appearance under my eyes. My only complaint is that it has a slight chemical smell. I prefer my face products to be scent free.

I am always looking for the best eye serums and creams out there. This one did not disappoint! I loved the combination of products in one bottle. I will say pumping it out takes some getting the hang of it, because you have to be sure to push them so they evenly come out. That is the only reason I took off a star, the packaging is not perfect. As far as the product itself, it gives a nice cooling feeling as it works, and smooths nicely. This is definitely something I will add into my facial rotation. I do get Botox a twice a year, but I like to use products to lengthen the time I can go between Botox sessions. This works very well for that!

I received this HCF Triple Eye Serum as part of a campaign. It is a very lovely eye serum - goes on smooth and very hydrating and it works well under makeup. There are times it feels likes more product is coming out of one side vs all 3 sides. I did not notice much of a difference in minimizing fine lines and reducing discoloration. Probably one of the better eye serums I have used.
I love this eye serum. It's lightweight, not greasy, absorbs well and it works! I have noticed an improvement in my wrinkles and fine lines and discoloration.

avis.titre: Delicious texture that plumps fine lines
avis.texte: I am impressed with the results I am getting from this eye serum, but I have my reservations about the packaging. I received a free sample in exchange for my honest review, which I appreciate because Lancome products are outside of my typical budget. I have used Vitamin C, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid before, but wanted to add ferulic acid to the mix. This is the first product I've tried that has all four and clearly my skin is loving the combination! The texture of this is wonderful and easily absorbed, it is definitely a creamier type of serum. I hope I am getting all of the components out of the bottle because it has 3 chambers but when I pump it, serum only comes out of two holes. That is my only reservation about the product--the packaging. The formula is clearly effective at plumping my fine lines and moisturizing my crepey under eyes. I like that I can use it in the morning as well because the texture isn't sticky and my makeup doesn't pill. The texture is similar to the Strivectin tripeptide undereye gel, which also has multiple textures swirled together (premixed). I do like that this pump has separate ingredients that you combine together after they leave the chamber. I highly recommend it and will purchase it again, now that I've confirmed it is an effective product for my skin.

I really like this product. I like the container and how it dispenses the perfect amount of product. The smell is very nice and the way the product feels on my skin is incredible. I've used the product for a few weeks now and I feel that it is making a difference. My skin looks more radiant and feels so smooth.

I have been using this religiously for a few weeks and am in awe of the results!! I was seriously considering Botox by my eyes but didn't want to completely lose my smile lines. This has provided smoothing and decrease in depth of lines after just a few weeks!

I've been using the Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. This eye serum is nothing short of transformative. The triple-action formula combines the power of hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, and ferulic acid to address multiple concerns, and it delivers on its promises. From the moment I applied it, I noticed a delightful cooling sensation that feels incredibly soothing. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue behind—perfect for layering under makeup. My under-eye area looks noticeably brighter and more even, and I've seen a significant reduction in the appearance of fine lines and puffiness. The serum has a subtle, pleasant fragrance that makes the application feel like a little moment of luxury. Overall, Lancôme has created a standout product with the Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye. It's become an essential part of my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to revitalize their eye area and achieve a more youthful, refreshed look.

I love this facial serum! I expected a good product, as Lancôme is a high end company, but wow! My face and neck were softer, and the scum was smoother. I wish it were not so expensive or I would use all over. This is one high price product that is worth the money. I will buy again.

I had high hopes for the Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum, but unfortunately, it didn't live up to my expectations. The concept of three distinct serums in one bottle sounded promising, but the design is flawed. The bottle has three separate holes meant to dispense the different serums simultaneously. However, after just a few uses, two of the holes became clogged, and now only one of the serums is consistently coming out. Given the high price of this product, I expected a much better experience. It's disappointing to pay a premium for a product that doesn't function as it should. Until Lancôme addresses this design issue, I can't recommend this serum, as it's just not worth the frustration or the cost.

This trip serum and cream is fantastic for everyday eye concerns such as puffy eyes, dark circles and wrinkles / fine lines. It applies so smoothly and absorbs quickly enough to do my makeup within a few minutes. It's improved the overall look of my eyes and brightened them up! I'd continue using this beyond this first bottle! Great for the price as it goes a long way.
I was surprised how well the Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye worked for me. My fine wrinkles, dark circles, and puffy eyes were improved. A little bit goes a long way.
I'm almost done with it! And I can say that this makes my skin look so healthy and smooth. The formula is lightweight yet efficient! My skin looks the best with it.

avis.titre: Triple Eye Serum good for aging skin
avis.texte: **Review: Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye** I've been using the Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye twice a day for the past eight weeks, and here's my experience so far. The serum comes in a convenient pump, which requires you to mix it before applying it to your eye area. I found the process easy to use, and it integrates well into my daily routine. In terms of short-term benefits, I've noticed that the area under my eyes becomes more firm after applying the serum. It also creates a smooth base for makeup, and I can definitely see an immediate improvement after use. However, when it comes to long-term results, I haven't seen a significant reduction in the fine lines around my eyes yet. Despite using it consistently, the serum has mostly provided short-term effects. That said, I'm still hopeful and will continue to use it in hopes of seeing more lasting improvements. Overall, I believe this product is worth the cost. If you're looking for a product that provides instant firmness and a better makeup application, I would recommend giving this a try. I'll update my review if I notice more substantial long-term changes.

I received lancome H.C.E Triple Serum to test in exchange for my honest review and wow! As a busy mom and business owner, sleep seems to be a luxury so I tend to wear the evidence on my eyes. I suffer from puffy dark circles, and at 44 wrinkles are becoming more present. Let me tell you though, this serum snatched my eyes! The puffiness dark circles, wrinkles all reduced tremendously. Time capsule in a bottle! I applied a very small pea size drop before applying my makeup and you can literally see it working before your eyes. The best part is that it does not dry your skin out or leave a white residue like other eye creams. Huge bonus. My only reason for not giving 5 stars is that the "triple" serum sometimes does not dispense with all three serums so you have to pump more product to get all 3 but that's truly my only complaint. It's 100 percent worth it!

This product is pricey. I thought that perhaps it's because of the packaging, but after trying it for a while I can safely say that the packaging is not a gimmick. It separates the serums and cream and combines them once dispensed. This product shortens my routine because I don't have to apply the products separately. It also does what it says. It hydrates and brightens. I think it has helped with the crapeyness under my eyes. Also, a little goes a long way, so this product lasts a long time. I will be purchasing this when I run out. It's worth it!

Slick, but how I want it to be. A little goes a long way. Funny little pump bottle feels a bit unnecessary, but whatever. It doesn't seem to interfere with makeup application & I can really see a difference when I've been using it vs not. I even go above the brow because I notice a difference.

Thank you to BzzAgent for letting me try Lancôme's Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum. I was really looking forward to it because the skin around my eyes has been changing with age and since having kids, and it could use some extra TLC. There are definitely some positives: the serum is very hydrating, it smells nice, and one pump gives you a lot of product. On the flip side, the price is pretty steep, and I found that it irritated my minor eczema flare-ups and sensitive skin. That single pump providing so much product is also a con; I almost always had more than needed for around my eyes, and rubbed it into my 11 lines, and around my mouth. After using it for a month, I didn't see a noticeable difference anywhere, and the minor burning sensation was off-putting. Because of the high cost and the lack of visible results, I wouldn't repurchase this serum. It's not what I would expect based on the description and marketing of the product.
I'm loving the texture of this eye cream. It is silky smooth. Great addition to my skin care routine. Great for fine lines and wrinkles. Yay

This triple eye serum has really helped my eyes look better and has helped with my dark circles. It makes me feel refreshed and I look younger as well. In just a couple of weeks I could really tell the difference. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is due to the packaging, a bit messy to use. I would highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Love this serum, not the packaging
avis.texte: This serum really felt great on the skin. Prior to trying it I had been using individual serums to customize my skincare, but this product really saved a lot of time. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and I do feel it has given moisture and plumping look. I do not like that the packaging doesn't show how much product is left, and the 3 serums each come out of a separate little spout making 1 even pump for all 3 much more product then needed for just the eye area. So much so that I thought maybe it was meant to be a full face serum. For the price, I wish there was better control of product being dispensed as well as seeing how much is left. I received a free sample of this product in exchange for an honest review of its performance.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it so much! 😭
avis.texte: After using this product for a couple weeks I learned that I loved it but it did not like me. It did help keep my under eyes moisturized… it did not do wonders for my bags or dark circles though. I would have had to use it longer to possibly achieving that goal. I was in love with the product even without those results. The thing that made me down a star was that I was heart broken to learn that it made my skin break out. I do recommend for anyone that doesn't have sensitive skin though.
